name: nk-autosave
description: Saves Notekeeping work when a session goes idle: runs /nk:save --unattended after a set time with no prompt, once per break, in sessions where a Notekeeping skill ran and something was written since the last save.

idle_save_minutes.title: Idle minutes before a save
idle_save_minutes.description: How long a session sits idle after Claude's last reply before nk-autosave saves it. Meant for auto-mode sessions; in manual mode the save's writes ask as usual. Under 55 keeps the save on a warm prompt cache. 0 turns idle saves off.

idle_save_promote.title: Promote on idle saves
idle_save_promote.description: Off: the idle save writes the work item's record and sets lasting facts aside (--no-promote); the next save you run promotes them. On: the idle save promotes as a normal save does.
